summary: More upgrade prerequisites: back up first, capture inventory and instance group details, review gateway network ports and required inventory variables, and if controller is behind a load balancer and the gateway UI shows Error connecting to Controller API, add the gateway URL to CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGIN in settings.py on each controller and restart.
questions: How do I fix Error connecting to Controller API after upgrading to 2.6?
What is CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGIN in automation controller?
What should I back up before upgrading AAP?

answer_card.title: Fix "Error connecting to Controller API" after upgrade
answer_card.answer_md: When controller is behind a load balancer, the gateway UI can fail to reach it after a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade. On each automation controller host, add the platform gateway URL to `CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGIN` in `settings.py`, then restart each controller host.
